04001.story: As of Oct 12, the record here runs 75 years, from 1951 to 2025. On the middle value of the county's 63 grids, May to June is the driest pair with a normal of 0.80 inches, and it came in under 90% of normal in 41 of those years. On that same middle, July to August came in at 35% of normal in 2025, and March to April came in at 39% of normal so far in 2026.

preliminary.means: an estimate from NOAA rain, not RMA's index; RMA's final index can differ

Grid 13583 had its driest year in 1956 at 41%.
